import subprocess

# Run tests overriding the pytest config
result = subprocess.run(
    ["python", "-m", "pytest", "-q", "-x", "-p", "no:cacheprovider", 
     "-o", "addopts=", "test_semver.py"],
    capture_output=True, text=True
)
print("STDOUT:", result.stdout[-5000:])
print("STDERR:", result.stderr[-1000:] if result.stderr else "")
print("Return code:", result.returncode)
